SavedVerse.title: SavedVerse
SavedVerse.description: A Quran verse or Hadith saved by a user with an optional personal reflection note.

sourceType.description: Whether the quote is from Quran or Hadith.

reference.description: Human-readable citation such as Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286 or Sahih al-Bukhari 6018.

arabicText.description: Original Arabic text of the verse or hadith.

reflectionNote.description: Personal reflection note written by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DhikrLog.title: DhikrLog
DhikrLog.description: Daily Salawat and dhikr counter log plus daily 5-prayer milestone checklist.

salawatCount.description: Total Salawat count logged on this date.

tasbihCount.description: Total general dhikr/tasbih count logged on this date.

completedPrayers.description: List of completed daily prayer names (up to 6).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DhikrProfile.title: DhikrProfile
DhikrProfile.description: Aggregate Salawat milestone and streak summary for a user.

unlockedMilestones.description: Milestone IDs unlocked by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/saved_verses/{verseId}.description: User's personalized archive of favorite Quran verses and Hadiths with reflection notes.

/users/{userId}/dhikr_logs/{logId}.description: Daily Salawat dhikr counts and Solat prayer completion logs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.

/users/{userId}/dhikr_profile/{profileId.description: User's lifetime Salawat summary and unlocked spiritual milestones.
